chosenApproach: Add one bounded, read-only, exact-scope RPC plus reusable weekly/monthly UI under existing Report page and member CSV, while leaving canonical daily RPCs untouched.
selectionRationale: A server-side scope-gated aggregation prevents cross-scope member leakage and duplicate submissions and avoids unnecessary per-member mobile network requests.
alternativeApproaches: Reuse only v1 daily member RPC and derive monthly client-side: rejected because historical dates and authoritative scope approvals are absent.
Rewrite canonical daily summary v3: rejected because it risks existing daily behavior and shared formation reports.
Selected: additive period RPC and isolated report component.
